entries.note: What the ExchangeabilityMaps slides show, the tests, and each case's rejecting area against its permutation null (rewritten by figure-slides); the slides carry no title.

All members pooled (5 November models for DJF lead 2-4; 6 models for the decade). Rows: DJF lead months 2-4, one value per start date; the s1961/s1978 decade with each model's month-of-year climatology removed. Excess I(M; X, Y) where p <= 0.05, exact nulls (per-member detrend inside the test; per start date / 12-month blocks), 200 permutations. Inputs: $SNP_OUT/exchangeability_grid_{VAR}_2-4_redetrend.npz, _{VAR}_{s1961,s1978}moy_block12_redetrend.npz.

CanESM5 alone. Rows: DJF lead months 12-14 (CanESM5 starts in January, so its first full DJF is a year after the start), one value per start date; the s1961/s1978 decade, month-of-year climatology removed. Same statistic, nulls, colour scale and area axis as exchangeability-all-models. Inputs: $SNP_OUT/exchangeability_grid_{VAR}_CanESM5_12-14_redetrend.npz, _{VAR}_{s1961,s1978}moy_CanESM5_block12_redetrend.npz.

What each RhoLambdaMaps slide shows (data, rows, tests, marks, sample sizes) and how to regenerate it; the slides carry no title.

All members pooled (five November models), DJF lead months 2-4, one value per start date. Top: Pearson rho RPC; bottom: Knuth lambda RPC with lambda_m and lambda_o from s_-n (observations' T values only, never tiled). Dots: the 5-95% interval of 1000 Eade bootstrap draws contains 1 (rho: boot fd; lambda: boot olmloo, full-data bins); green rings: lambda changes by more than itself from 0.5x to 1.5x bins; grey: rho_o <= 0 or lambda undefined. Inputs: $SNP_OUT/boot_{fd,olmloo}_{SLP,PRECT,TREFHT}_2-4.npz (scripts/boot.py; .claude/scripts/rho_lambda_boot.sbatch).

All members pooled (six models), the monthly decade with each model's month-of-year climatology removed: SLP and TREFHT s1961moy, PRECT s1978moy. Same rows, tests and marks as rho-lambda-lead2-4 (bootstrap resamples whole years). Inputs: $SNP_OUT/boot_{fd,olmloo}_{SLP_s1961moy,PRECT_s1978moy,TREFHT_s1961moy}.npz.
